title: pgvector 0.6.0 Parallel HNSW Builds: What Speeds Up, and the Docker /dev/shm Trap
excerpt: pgvector 0.6.0 builds HNSW indexes in parallel. On a 4 vCPU runner it built a 200,000-row index 4.0 times faster than 0.5.1, but in Docker's default 64 MB /dev/shm a parallel build with a larger maintenance_work_mem fails with error 53100.
